title: Brilliant e-mountain bike adventure from Granada.
text:
We met our guide 'Ruby' (Jorge) at the bike shop. The bikes are set up and then you're off, cycling up past the Alhambra and into the hills. The ebike I had was strong and powerful (I'm 1.87m tall).
The tour was fantastic, I think maybe 50km or more and included stunning mountains, gorges, villages, goats, rivers, a dramatic reservoir and dam, cliff edges and more. Of course also a coffee stop and a great authentic lunch. There is a good balance of off-road, gravel trails and quiet on-road and if you fancy some challenging downhill sections, you can go a little off-piste too.

title: Best way to see the city of Granada!
text:
We only had one day to spend in Granada and wanted to see as much as possible. We were in a group of 4 with two beginner level and two intermediate level experience on mountain bikes. Simon was our guide, he was great! He was able to customize the route for our experience level and desire to see some of nature and some of the city. He was the right amount of engaging and then letting us have our time to explore at a few spots. We have an amazing experience with this tour!

Get there early as you have to park a few streets away. They recommended we park at “Parking San Agustin” https://maps.app
author: Toni_M

title: Get busy living
text: We had an awesome bike ride with Simon! The bikes worked well and we covered a lot of ground. It was a spectacular way to spend a day in and around Granada! The entire ride was picturesque and we had several great photo opps. I would definitely recommend this to any active travelers who want to cover a lot of ground and get out in nature. The bikes are pedal assist and not throttle based, so you need to be active and capable! We would definitely do this again or use them for another route or biking experience!
author: F6086UCjayh

title: Back country mountain biking adventure
text: The ride was great, we are both experienced riders and found the trip well within our abilities. Riding through the hills gave us a good view of the highland back country . The guide Simon was fantastic and he made the trip, he went way beyond  normal and his friendly and open attitude helped make the whole experience even greater.
author: Taryn_S

title: Granada e-bike tour
text:
It was fantastic… Aa we are a bit on the older side (in our 60’s)  but fit.. Simon our amazing guide adjusted the tour slightly to include a mountain biking experience without the white knuckle elements.
He included a wonderful cycle tour of Granada at the end .. 
He was kind, friendly, informative and was a big part of the reason our tour was so much fun. The bikes were really high quality.
Great tour, can’t recommend it enough .

author: janemG3517YL

title: Wonderful experience
text: I had an amazing experience on this tour with the guide Fares. He prepared our bikes, went sure that everyone feels comfortable and guided the tour with a lots of interesting informations. His Englisch is very good and hes an experienced biker, that made me feel safe. The whole day was amazing!! I recommend it 100%!
author: lailal808

title: Unmissable experience
text: My son (14) and I had the best day. Truly amazing bike trip and our guide was fantastic too. The mountains are magnificent. Highlight of our holiday to Granada. I would highly recommend. During the ride we stopped  for a coffee / soft drink and later for lunch at a great restaurant. My only niggle however, if you copy the whole address including the company name off of TripAdvisor onto your maps it sends you to the wrong place.
author: nesanderson

title: A must for anyone who enjoys the outdoors
text: Such an amazing time! So many beautiful sights we otherwise would not have been able to see; mountains, olive fields, almond fields, and small town life. Our guide was Fares, he was so nice and fun, and also super cute. He told us of some local culture and customs toy just don’t get to learn in the city, and one of the restaurants we went too was one he used to go to as a kid! My friend and I had the whole tour to ourselves so we were able to go at our own pace without having to worry about others. Some spots were pretty rough and I would not recommend to inexperienced riders, but overall a go
author: X6787SWcatherinev

title: Fantastic experience with a 6-star guide!
text: Fantastic tour through the beautiful nature that is between Granada and Sierra Nevada. Was on tour with my son who is 14 years old and skilled on bicycle. Here there were challenges, if one wanted to take side paths, possibly follow the usual route as I did. Our guide Fares gets 6 stars. He was welcoming and very nice and could tell us a lot about nature and the small towns we drove through. This tour can be recommended and was a fantastic experience!
author: 974arnel

title: MTB from Granada
text: Great trip. We are quite experienced riders and we thoroughly enjoyed the day in the Sierra Nevada. Nice balance of fun riding, good sentry and excellent lunch stop. Jorge was an excellent guide
